dedupe_keys.name: 建築物衛生事業登録施設 buildings

description: 建築物衛生事業登録施設 [buildings] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 那覇市. 那覇市内において、建築物における衛生的環境の確保に関する法律第12条の2第1項に基づく登録を受けている施設を業種ごとにまとめております。 登録業種は8業種ありますが、建築物空気調和用ダクト清掃業および建築物飲料水水質検査業については那覇市内での登録はありません。. Coverage: 那覇市. The portal files it under the publisher 那覇市. It offers 6 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2026-09-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
